svg.title: PACELC
svg.desc: Two operations on the same Cassandra cluster with 3 replicas in each of two regions. Normally a like count write waits for one nearby replica and answers in about 2 ms, while a privacy write waits for 4 of 6 replicas, one across regions, and takes about 80 ms. When the link between regions drops, the like count still answers, and the privacy write fails because only 3 replicas can be reached.
svg.text: Normal days: fast or fresh, 2 ms vs 80 ms. Partitions: answer or refuse.
